acts.title: Somatic variant recovery
acts.subtitle: Alignment, somatic calling, and genomic characterisation of the tumour exome.

hotspots.label: STAR Alignment (Modal)
hotspots.blurb: Lines up the tumour's DNA reads against the human reference genome.

hotspots.label: VCF Parser (cyvcf2)
hotspots.blurb: Collects the DNA changes that appear in the tumour but not in healthy tissue.

hotspots.label: Variant Annotator (Ensembl VEP)
hotspots.blurb: Works out what each DNA change does to its gene and protein.

hotspots.label: RNA-seq Quantification
hotspots.blurb: Measures how strongly each gene is switched on in the tumour.

metric.name: RNA-quant correlation
metric.lit: gene-level RNA-seq quant is a standard expression-weighting input

hotspots.label: Allele-Specific Expression (ASE)
hotspots.blurb: Checks whether the mutated copy of the gene is actually expressed.

hotspots.label: Clonality Estimator
hotspots.blurb: Estimates how much of the tumour carries each mutation.

hotspots.label: Ensembl Protein Context Client
hotspots.blurb: Looks up the protein sequence surrounding each mutation.

hotspots.label: Simulation Modes (clean/noisy/hard)
hotspots.blurb: Generates controlled test data to check the pipeline behaves correctly.

hotspots.label: Peptide-table Passthrough
hotspots.blurb: Accepts a ready-made list of peptides when one is supplied.

acts.title: Presentation and immunogenicity
acts.subtitle: The mutated protein is processed and ranked for MHC-I presentation.

hotspots.label: HLA Typing
hotspots.blurb: Identifies the patient's HLA type — the MHC molecules that display peptides to T cells.

hotspots.label: Epitope Generator
hotspots.blurb: Slides a window across the protein to list every short peptide spanning the mutation.

hotspots.label: Proteasomal Processing Scorer
hotspots.blurb: Predicts where the cell's proteasome cuts the protein into peptides.

hotspots.label: MHC-I Binding Prediction
hotspots.blurb: Predicts how tightly each peptide binds the patient's MHC.

hotspots.label: BigMHC Immunogenicity
hotspots.blurb: Predicts whether a displayed peptide will actually provoke a T-cell response.

metric.name: Immunogenicity signal (binding-controlled)
metric.lit: binder-matched ceiling AUROC 0.52–0.60 (ITSNdb); BigMHC-IM 0.56 on hard negatives

hotspots.label: Immunogenicity Scorer
hotspots.blurb: Scores each peptide's overall likelihood of triggering an immune response.

hotspots.label: MUNIS (HLA-I presentation)
hotspots.blurb: A second, independent check on whether a peptide is displayed by the MHC.

metric.name: Presentation-rank agreement (Spearman ρ)
metric.lit: two independent EL predictors agree at ρ ≈ 0.6 (expected; MUNIS/NetMHCpan AUC 0.980/0.962)
metric.evidence: MUNIS vs NetMHCpan EL-rank, 8400 held-out peptides

hotspots.label: pMHC Stability Prediction
hotspots.blurb: Estimates how long a peptide stays bound to the MHC once loaded.

hotspots.label: pMHC Co-folding Orchestrator
hotspots.blurb: Models the 3-D structure of the peptide sitting in the MHC groove.

hotspots.label: ESMFold / AlphaFold (Modal)
hotspots.blurb: Predicts the folded shape of the peptide–MHC complex.

hotspots.label: T-SCAPE Immunogenicity
hotspots.blurb: An additional immunogenicity model contributing to the ensemble.

acts.title: Candidate selection
acts.subtitle: Composite prioritisation selects the immunogenic candidates.

hotspots.label: Neoantigen Priority Scorer
hotspots.blurb: Multi-feature priority score combining binding affinity, immunogenicity, agretopicity, expression, structural exposure, and clonality for Phase 2 neoantigen ranking.

acts.title: Coding-sequence and UTR design
acts.subtitle: Selected peptides are encoded as an optimised mRNA construct.

hotspots.label: Rigorous Codon Optimiser (Lagrangian)
hotspots.blurb: Phase 3 primary optimiser. Lagrangian relaxation over the synonymous codon graph: per-position argmax log(w) - lambda*gc with binary search on lambda to hit overall GC in [gc_lo, gc_hi]. Followed by local-window GC repair, uridine depletion, and restriction-site / homopolymer scrubbing. Closes the CAI ~0.90 gap that DNA Chisel's local search leaves on canine polyepitopes.

hotspots.label: Codon Optimizer (DNA Chisel)
hotspots.blurb: Reverse-translates amino acid sequences to codon-optimised CDS. DNA Chisel with the Kazusa canine codon table, strict overall GC [0.40, 0.60] and loose per-100-nt window [0.30, 0.70], maximising CAI via use_best_codon. Graceful fallback returns None so callers can use the table-based approach.

hotspots.label: mRNAid (Merck NAR 2024)
hotspots.blurb: Multi-objective CDS optimiser jointly optimising CAI, GC, MFE, and uridine depletion; produces N>=3 candidates natively. Optional dep — gracefully absent when not installed.

hotspots.label: Codon-Pair Bias (Coleman 2008)
hotspots.blurb: Computes mean Coleman codon-pair score (CPB) over adjacent codon pairs in a CDS sequence.  Acts as a soft tie-breaker in Phase 3 scoring (weight 0.05 by default, never overrides CAI / GC / MFE hard gates). Per-species CPS tables live at data/codon_pair_table_<species>.json.

hotspots.label: Phase 3 %MinMax Codon Profile
hotspots.blurb: Clarke & Clark 2008 sliding-window codon-usage profile. Reports windows biased toward common codons (+100 = pure max) vs rare codons (−100 = pure min). Advisory; never gates clearance.

hotspots.label: RNA Folding (ViennaRNA wrapper)
hotspots.blurb: Thin ViennaRNA wrapper. Uses the `viennarna` Python bindings (in-process) to compute minimum free energy and adjusted-MFE per 100 nt for codon and UTR optimisation in Phase 3/4.

hotspots.label: RNA Structure Prediction (ViennaRNA)
hotspots.blurb: ViennaRNA Python-bindings wrapper for MFE secondary-structure computation. Exposes compute_mfe, compute_amfe (MFE per 100 nt), and compute_mfe_window for subsequence analysis. Accepts DNA or RNA, any case; raises on sequences shorter than 10 nt. Used by CDS and UTR validation.

hotspots.label: UTR-LM (Modal GPU)
hotspots.blurb: Batched 5' UTR translation-efficiency scoring via the fine-tuned UTR-LM checkpoint on a Modal.com GPU container. Falls back to in-process inference when Modal credentials are absent.

hotspots.label: Out-of-Frame ATG / uORF Scanner
hotspots.blurb: Finds ATG codons in frames +1/+2 relative to the main ORF start. Reports Kozak strength (Kozak 1987: -3 purine AND +4 G). Advisory only — never gates manufacturing_cleared.

acts.title: Manufacturing clearance
acts.subtitle: Hazard, degradation, toxicity and yield checks on the final construct.

hotspots.label: Restriction Site Scanner
hotspots.blurb: Scans DNA for restriction enzyme recognition sites using Biopython's Bio.Restriction database (800+ enzymes). Exposes scan_restriction_sites (critical-enzymes subset) and scan_all_enzymes (full DB). Falls back to string matching against a minimal CRITICAL_ENZYMES list when Biopython is absent.

hotspots.label: RNA Degradation Scorer
hotspots.blurb: Per-nucleotide degradation risk for the assembled construct body. Runs every available backend in an equal-weight ensemble: ViennaRNA-based window heuristic, RNAdegformer (He 2023, when weights are vendored), and DegScore (Leppek 2022, when weights are vendored). Hotspots are advisory, never gate manufacturing.

hotspots.label: ToxinPred 3.0
hotspots.blurb: Polyepitope toxicity prediction (advisory). ML probability in [0, 1] that the translated polyepitope protein is toxic; never gates manufacturing clearance.

hotspots.label: IVT Yield Estimator
hotspots.blurb: Deterministic T7 in-vitro-transcription yield heuristic (advisory): yield as percent of theoretical max from length, GC, start nucleotides, and cap analog. Never gates manufacturing clearance.
